content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
content.Purpose: The guideline provides comprehensive recommendations for the management of atrial fibrillation.
Key Topics: Prevalence, Incidence, Morbidity, and Mortality of Atrial Fibrillation
content.Epidemiology: Includes trends in atrial fibrillation prevalence, incidence, risk factors, and outcomes.
References: 2020 ESC guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation
2018 AHA/ACC guideline on heart disease management
2020 AHA/ACC guideline for aortic stenosis management

genes.context: In studies evaluating genetic predisposition, alterations in the BRCA1 gene were associated with increased risk of atrial fibrillation in certain populations.
